cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 LAB — 172 Cases · Mirror Diagnostics + Touch R5
cyd32-st7798.summary: Unmerged 172-case LAB R5 for CYD 3.2 ST7798. Improves the experimental real-RGB565 LCD mirror: conservative 6 MHz TFT GRAM SPI read clock, captures actual calibration screen before touch calibration, MIRROR DIAG reports hardware readback/baud, and accepts a slow but authentic 115200 fallback when Windows COM reconnect resets 2Mbps UART. Windows Workbench v0.4.1 requires firmware MIRROR READY before requesting frames, reports bad baud or unreadable LCD explicitly, and maps mouse DOWN/MOVE/UP to native touch controls. TFT readback, colors, latency and physical touch are unverified. Stable production v1.1.0 unchanged; SHA-256 segment preflight mandatory.
highlights: R5 LCD diagnostic: MIRROR DIAG returns READY, CAL, physical LCD SIZE, real BAUD, TFT RGB565 sample variation and free heap.
LCD GRAM read clock reduced from 20MHz to 6MHz to improve reliability on ST7798/ST7789-compatible boards.
Real LCD capture works even before touchscreen calibration; remote touch still requires calibration.
Slow authentic RGB565 full-frame capture is available at default 115200 if USB COM reconnect resets UART; allow 20–40s for first frame.
Windows EXE 0.4.1 requires actual MIRROR READY acknowledgment, and clearly reports unsupported firmware, wrong baud, panel-readback failure.
Live 2Mbps mode retains nonblocking two-row streaming and exact changed-row deltas and touch release; do not fabricate screenshots.
172 bounded synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi cases; selected 3–30s duration; unique synthetic identities; verify four firmware segments by SHA-256.
Real hardware validation of GRAM readback, touchscreen navigation and full-motion latency is still pending.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 Waveshare C5 LAB — 172 Synthetic Signals · Named Scenarios
c5-waveshare-28.summary: Unmerged Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8-inch LAB build with 172 time-limited synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi cases and descriptive device-first signal names. USB LCD mirroring is NOT implemented for this board; the experimental MIRROR command returns unsupported on non-CYD builds. Four-part SHA-256 flashing preflight remains required; physical C5 verification is pending.
highlights: USB mirror work is CYD 3.2 specific; C5 physical screen mirroring is not yet supported.
Native list names all 172 synthetic signals by device; case IDs remain below each label.
172 shared detection cases and negative controls.
27 UAV vendor Wi-Fi test beacons; no genuine drone RF claim.
Controlled, time-limited tests with serial truth reporting.
Four-part SHA-256 preflight, including C5 bootloader at 0x2000.
Requires exact Waveshare C5 2.8-inch touch hardware.

s3-devkit.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 ESP32-S3 LAB — 172-Case Serial Detection Matrix
s3-devkit.summary: Unmerged ESP32-S3 LAB firmware with 172 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi scenarios, bounded serial RUN/STOP/SUITE commands and tracked on-air identities. This S3 devkit build does not expose CYD LCD framebuffer or touch control; MIRROR is unsupported. Four-part SHA-256 verified flashing preflight remains required; physical S3 verification is pending.
highlights: No screen mirroring on ESP32-S3 DevKit without a display: unsupported MIRROR command.
172 shared synthetic scenarios and negative controls.
USB serial RUN, STOP and SUITE for bounded transmitter tests.
Vendor OUI-only beacons are not authentic aircraft broadcasts.
Four-segment firmware SHA-256 integrity preflight.
No CYD touchscreen interface is claimed for S3.
